# Escrow decision examples, written from the plain-language rules before
# reading the generated table. Provenance: written by an AI agent (the same
# one that wrote v2/policy.json), so they are not an independent oracle.
# The study's 23 examples, each on one line, with each payout a delivery of
# its own: a split pays the buyer and the seller in two deliveries.
#
# status held funded to_seller to_buyer funded_at shipped_at action amount refund caller now | outcome reason post-state | payouts: channel payee amount, separated by ;

# action 170 Fund 171 Ship 172 Confirm 173 Dispute 174 Resolve 175 Cancel 176 Claim
# ship deadline = funded_at + 604800; dispute deadline = shipped_at + 1209600
#
